name: Signed Minimal Nonfaces Parametrize Every Fixed-Shadow Ample Family
statement: Let $\Sigma\subseteq2^F$ be a simplicial complex and choose a trace $\sigma_I\in Q_I$ for every minimal nonface $I\in\mathcal N(\Sigma)$. Put $H(\Sigma,\boldsymbol\sigma)=\{x\in Q_F:x|_I\ne\sigma_I\text{ for all }I\in\mathcal N(\Sigma)\}$. The signing is admissible when $|H(\Sigma,\boldsymbol\sigma)|=|\Sigma|$. Sending an ample $H$ with $\operatorname{Sh}(H)=\Sigma$ to the unique trace omitted on every minimal nonface is a bijection onto the admissible signings, with inverse $\boldsymbol\sigma\mapsto H(\Sigma,\boldsymbol\sigma)$. Thus the signed minimal nonfaces determine the entire ample family.
proof: Projection to a minimal nonface remains ample and has shattered complex $2^I\setminus\{I\}$, so Sandwich equality says that it omits exactly one trace. The original family lies in the avoidance family of these traces. The latter shatters no nonface of $\Sigma$, so the upper Sandwich bound gives $|H(\Sigma,\boldsymbol\sigma_H)|\le|\Sigma|=|H|$ and forces equality. Conversely an admissible avoidance family has shattered complex contained in $\Sigma$ and cardinality $|\Sigma|$; both Sandwich inequalities are equalities, proving ampleness and exact shadow.
